name: Raccoon
summary: The mask across the eyes, the striped tail.
text:
A dark mask around the eyes and a striped tail, both painted by hand. It sits with its paws together and its belly full of light.

A piece with plenty of character, for children who have started choosing what goes on their own walls.

options.name: Power
options.help: Batteries are not included. The mains version comes with a remote: on, off, dimmer, timer and a slow pulse.

options.name: Laser engraving
options.help: A name, a date or a short phrase, burned into the wood. Leave it empty if you would rather not.
